sources.title: KDDI July 28 partnership release names the service provided by Osaka Sakai
sources.summary: The dated operator release describes on-premises Gemini on GDC as provided by the named Osaka Sakai Data Center, separately from the prospective startup trial offer. Root is reviewing this current-service assertion as the fresh operations confirmation; no customer trial completion is inferred.

sources.title: KDDI announces Osaka Sakai Data Center operation on January 22
sources.summary: Historical named facility opening and acquired-property identity, with a labelled exterior photograph. Explicitly states that KDDI acquired the Sharp property in April 2025. Outside the fresh admission window.

sources.title: KDDI labelled Osaka Sakai exterior photograph
sources.summary: January operator release labels this image as Osaka Sakai Data Center exterior. The KDDI-branded block, roof spine, offices and adjacent factory corridor support location matching. Photograph acquisition day is unestablished.

sources.title: KDDI Spark Journal Osaka Sakai opening interview
sources.summary: Operator interview names and labels the converted factory and its photograph. Historical identity and operating context only; no current capacity or completion of future development inferred.

sources.title: KDDI Spark Journal labelled Osaka Sakai exterior from another angle
sources.summary: Another operator-labelled view of the same KDDI-branded block shows the long roof cooling spine, adjacent office bars, factory corridor and open strip. Used only for identity matching; acquisition day unknown.

sources.title: CBRE identifies KDDI acquired former color-filter facility
sources.summary: Firsthand acquisition adviser identifies the land/buildings of the former color-filter production facility within Green Front Sakai, about 33,000 square metres of site area and 57,000 square metres of floor area. Reports the transaction closed April 4, 2025. Areas distinguish the property; they are not converted to power.

sources.title: KDDI April 4 Sharp property purchase contract
sources.summary: KDDI identifies its purchased former Sharp Sakai property and the Osaka Sakai Data Center development. Historical transaction identity only; future operation in this source is not the selected current status.

sources.title: Sharp confirms property transfer and handover to KDDI
sources.summary: Seller states the sale contract and property transfer/handover occurred April 4, 2025. The acquired land and buildings are in Sakai-ku; no surveyed boundary is supplied. Historical acquisition fact, not an independent current legal-title check.

sources.title: SoftBank separately contracts for Sharp Sakai LCD plant property
sources.summary: Separate SoftBank transaction covers about 450,000 square metres of land and 840,000 square metres of buildings. This identity context must not be merged with KDDI former color-filter property or treated as fresh SoftBank operations.

sources.title: Esri World Imagery for the reviewed KDDI Sakai property
sources.attribution: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.summary: Georeferenced image matches the two named operator photographs. Used for an approximate property/campus marker only; acquisition date and absolute positional accuracy unknown.

sources.title: Esri returned Sakai export extent and dimensions
sources.attribution: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.summary: Returned WGS84 extent and 1400 by 1200 dimensions reproduce the selected pixel-center coordinate. The returned extent differs from the requested box to fit the aspect ratio. Direct image request and the JSON-returned image have identical SHA-256 hashes.

sources.title: Esri World Imagery service metadata and attribution
sources.attribution: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.summary: Service metadata supplies attribution. Generic advertised imagery resolution does not bound accuracy at this campus.
sources.date_semantics: Spatial/technical context only; retrieval is not a lifecycle observation.

sources.title: ArcGIS REST Export Map documentation
sources.summary: Export JSON supplies the actual returned map extent, dimensions and scale. Esri warns that extent can change to fit the aspect ratio, so the calculation uses the returned extent and explicitly requested image spatial reference.
sources.date_semantics: Spatial or identity context only. Retrieval date is neither image acquisition date nor a lifecycle status observation.

sources.title: KDDI confirms March 27 trial launch at Osaka Sakai
sources.summary: Historical context: April 30 release confirms trial provision of Gemini on GDC began March 27 at named Osaka Sakai facility. Full commercial service targets 2027. This clarifies the service referred to by July 28 current assertion; April is not selected as fresh status.
sources.date_semantics: April 30 publication reports March 27 achieved trial launch and 2027 full commercial target.

source_reuse: Canonical Esri metadata and export-documentation source objects retained exactly. Raw source bodies and imagery stay local and are not redistributed.
